rationale: A unanimous, narrow, text-and-structure holding ("shall stay" when requested) with an emphasis on preserving FAA §16’s calibrated appellate scheme makes the Chief Justice the most likely majority author. Any separate writing is most likely to be a short textualist concurrence (Thomas/Gorsuch/Barrett) or a pragmatic/access-to-courts concurrence (Sotomayor), but the incentives in a 9–0 case favor a single clean opinion.
